title: 20 INCIDENCE & VOLUME OF THE IPC CRIMES UNDER DIFFERENT CRIME-HEADS IN STATES, UTs AND CITIES: 1.7 The State/UT/City-wise statistics relating to the incidence of crime under the important crime-heads of the IPC alongwith the volume of crime for the year 1991 are given in Table-6. Uttar Pradesh alone contributed more than 30 per cent towards Murder' & 'Attempt To Commit Murder', and 29 per cent towards 'Robbery' cases registered in the country. Similarly, Bihar contributed 29.4 per cent towards 'Dacoity' and Madhya Pradesh contributed about 25 per cent towards 'Rape' cases registered in the country. The comparative statistics relating to incidence of crime during 1990 and 1991 alongwith the percentage variation in the current year over the previous year under the same crime-heads are presented in Table-7.
